name: cover
prompt: Create a new Korean blog title cover, square. Toss-inspired clear editorial typography and restrained white/cyan/cobalt palette, no Toss branding. Lower half is a realistic wide-angle sunlit modern home workspace: open laptop with abstract unreadable pale interface and a plain smartphone, a small neutral physical USB security key rests beside it, no logos. A translucent pale-blue rounded shield motif gently integrated into the photographic composition, tasteful modern fintech editorial visual. Generous whitespace, huge bold text, naturally photographed hardware and wood texture; completely different from farmland, coins, paper-craft and weather covers. No invented claims or approval checkmarks.
